mp.loadFailed: Failed to load the Mercado Pago connection.
mp.startFailed: Couldn't start the connection with Mercado Pago.
mp.disconnectDescription: You won't be able to receive new subscriptions or store sales until you reconnect. Active subscribers keep going as usual; ongoing recurring charges continue.
mp.connectDescription: Required to charge for Subscriptions and in the Store. Payments go straight to your Mercado Pago account; the platform only keeps a R$ 1 fee per sale (waived on Pro Max).

manual.show: Dev mode: connect manually without OAuth
manual.tokenLabel: Mercado Pago Access Token (seller test user)
manual.hint: Skips OAuth, useful when localhost has no HTTPS for the Mercado Pago callback.

tebex.connectedToast: Tebex connected. The packages already show up in your store.
tebex.disconnectDescription: The Tebex packages leave your store. Your account and your sales on Tebex stay there.
tebex.connectedDescription: Your store shows the Tebex packages. Payment, delivery and refunds happen on Tebex, with no platform fee.
tebex.title: Sell through Tebex
tebex.description: Optional. Shows the packages from your Tebex store here. Buyers pay on Tebex, no Discord needed.
tebex.tokenHint: Get it at {link}. Never paste the Private Key: it isn't needed.

stripe.linkExpired: The Stripe sign-up link expired. Continue the sign-up again.
stripe.disconnectDescription: The store stops accepting payments through Stripe. Your Stripe account still exists.
stripe.connectedDescription: The store accepts cards through Stripe, including from outside Brazil.
stripe.pendingDescription: The button only shows up in the store after Stripe approves your account.
stripe.title: Accept cards through Stripe
stripe.description: Optional. The money goes straight to your Stripe account; the platform only keeps a R$ 1 fee per sale (waived on Pro Max).
